correctness.rationale: The Fibonacci/Lucas cubes obey the same order-four integer reversible recurrence. The Lucas-cube shift identity and transfer 4x4 matrix of determinant 5^6 establish equality of p-adic gcd valuations for all p!=5. Exact mod-5 periods 20 and 4 and mod-25 Lucas subwindow residues settle 4|k not 20|k. At k=20t, companion C^20=I+5B and the normalized binomial-geometric sum U_t is congruent I mod5, hence invertible; n20 mod125 vector valuations are respectively 1 and 2, giving exact shift at every t. Independently checked 320 complete four-window gcds and base residues, not mistaken for a proof for all k.
